zh.title: 法國與瑞典完成雙邊航空演習 Rafale 與 Gripen 共同參演
zh.summary: 瑞典國防軍表示，這是兩國在雙邊前沿嚇阻架構下的首次聯合演習。
body: 瑞典國防軍宣佈，法國與瑞典於11月16日至18日在瑞典北部舉行 Excalibur 航空演習。依瑞方說法，這是兩國在雙邊前沿嚇阻架構下舉行的首場聯合演習。
瑞方公告指出，法國派出 Rafale 戰機及支援機，與瑞典空軍 Gripen 戰機共同參與。演習旨在展示兩國空軍在同一架構下協同運作的能力。
瑞典國防軍將這次演習列為兩國落實戰略合作路線圖的一環。瑞方在演習結束後公佈結果，並確認參演期間為三天。

en.title: France and Sweden complete first air exercise under bilateral deterrence framework
en.summary: French Rafale and Swedish Gripen fighters took part in the Excalibur exercise in northern Sweden.
body: French and Swedish air forces held Excalibur in northern Sweden from November 16 to 18, the Swedish Armed Forces said. It was their first joint exercise under a bilateral forward deterrence framework.

The Swedish statement said French Rafale fighters and support aircraft participated alongside Swedish Air Force Gripen fighters. The exercise demonstrated the ability of the two air forces to operate together.
Sweden described the exercise as part of implementing the two countries’ roadmap for strategic cooperation. The Swedish Armed Forces announced the three-day event after it had concluded.

facts.claim: Excalibur was held in northern Sweden from November 16 to 18.
French Rafale and Swedish Gripen aircraft participated.
Sweden described it as the first exercise under the bilateral framework.
